note: Allow-list of temp directory NAMES that docs/ops/temp-retention.cjs may plan for removal (directly under a temp root, only when older than the age cut). Anything not matched here is 'foreign' and never touched. Patterns are single path segments; * and ? are wildcards. Each pattern carries the reason it is safe: a fixture or scratch of OUR tests, seats or launches whose result is recorded in project files (reports, journals, Evidence). A KEPT PER-LAUNCH DIRECTORY is not on this list: it is found by its marker file .colabs-launch-tmp.json (schema launch-tmp/1, written by docs/ops/lib/work-root.cjs), never by a name pattern, so a bare leaf is found on every root and a directory without the marker is never touched.
